subject: Compact compliance walkthrough — evening window request & conflict
body:
From: Aria Patel <aria@clearbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearbridge.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 15:14:00 +0000
Subject: SOC2 / PEN handoff — compact evening walkthrough possible?

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding chat last week. Clearbridge would like to run a compact walkthrough (SOC2 scope + pen-test intake + DPA questions) ahead of our procurement review. Our security team prefers an evening slot (US EST friendly) to avoid disrupting engineering — would Redwood be able to host a 60–75 minute slot next week between 20:00–22:00 UTC?

High-level agenda:
- SOC2 scope + controls map (20 min)
- Pen-test intake & allowed activity + vendor questions (25 min)
- DPA retention & ingress/egress (15 min)
- Q&A and next steps (10–15 min)

We can have Marco Li (our external pen vendor) join for the pen intake portion. I attached a short CSV of priority systems and would share the SOC2 evidence map after we lock a time.

Options that work on our side (all UTC):
- Wed 2026-06-03 20:30–21:45
- Thu 2026-06-04 21:00–22:15
- Fri 2026-06-05 20:00–21:15

Appreciate a confirmation or alternates — we can be flexible by an hour either side.

Best,
Aria Patel
Security Programs Manager
Clearbridge Capital

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aria Patel <aria@clearbridge.com>, Marco Li <m.li@thirdpartysec.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 17:02:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 / PEN handoff — compact evening walkthrough possible?

Ben/Jordan — forwarding Aria's times. Two asks from our side before we lock:
1) Can we run this in a 60-minute compressed format if we keep the pre-read tight? (we'd split SOC2 and pen intake into 20/25 and push DPA into the tail)
2) I may need a short network/ops diagram attached for the pen vendor — Jordan, can you attach the redwood-network-diagram.pdf and confirm someone from infra (you or your oncall) can join the first 15?

My availability (UTC):
- Wed 2026-06-03 20:30–21:45 (good, but I have a leadership sync at 21:00; could join late)
- Thu 2026-06-04 21:00–22:15 (blocked for me)
- Fri 2026-06-05 20:00–21:15 (possible if we make it 60 min starting 20:00)

Ben — can you cover the 20:30 Wed start if I am delayed? If not, propose we go Fri 20:00–21:00 UTC compressed.

-Kim
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aria Patel <aria@clearbridge.com>, Marco Li <m.li@thirdpartysec.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC2 / PEN handoff — compact evening walkthrough possible?

Kim, Jordan — I can take point on Wed 20:30 UTC and hold it to 75 minutes. I prefer we keep the pen intake focused: allowed endpoints, test windows, and contact list. Jordan — can you confirm the infra attendee and share the diagram?

Aria — thanks for the options. Wed 20:30 UTC works for us if Kimberly can join shortly after she wraps her sync. If Kimberly can't make it, I'll run the session and loop her on the SOC2 controls section recording.

Quick logistics:
- Meeting bridge: redwood.zoom.us/meet/clearbridge-0603 (I'll create and share the link)
- Pre-read: please upload the SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx to the Drive link you mentioned so we can skim ahead of the call.

Ben Carter
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

---

On Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:08:00 +0000, Aria Patel <aria@clearbridge.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben/Kim,
>
> Thanks — Wednesday at 20:30 UTC is fine for us. One small hitch: our legal team just flagged that some DPA questions need a separate 30-minute slot with procurement and privacy (they're not available Wed evening). Would Redwood be open to handling the SOC2 + pen intake on Wed 20:30–21:45 and then scheduling a short DPA follow-up the following week with procurement? If yes, we can keep Wed focused and confirm a separate DPA slot.
>
> Also, Marco will join only for the pen intake (he's in APAC, so will be late evening for him).
>
> I'll upload the evidence CSV now and share the Drive link in a follow-up in case you need it for pre-read.
>
> Cheers,
> Aria
> Security Programs Manager
> Clearbridge Capital

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aria Patel <aria@clearbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC2 / PEN handoff — compact evening walkthrough possible? (confirmed)

Aria/Ben/Jordan — thanks for the quick sync. Wed 2026-06-03 20:30–21:45 UTC is confirmed. Ben will lead; Jordan, please stand by for the first 20 minutes to answer infra/network questions and drop the redwood-network-diagram.pdf into the Drive.

Aria — happy to separate the DPA-specific procurement Qs to a 30-minute follow-up next week; suggest Tue 2026-06-09 15:00–15:30 UTC (we'll circulate alternatives if that doesn't work).

Attachments for the Wed call (pre-read):
- SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx (expected list of artifacts by control)
- redwood-network-diagram.pdf (infra diagram for pen intake)

Ben will share the Zoom link and calendar invite in the next hour. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Kim
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

---

Attachments referenced: SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood-network-diagram.pdf (diagram stub).

Quoted/forwarded-message headers preserved.
